dataStudio.name: Simple Analytics
dataStudio.description: Connect Google Data Studio to pageview and event data in your Simple Analytics account. A Simple Analytics account and API key are required. Create an account at https://www.simpleanalytics.com/signup and follow the setup instructions at https://docs.simpleanalytics.com/google-data-studio.
dataStudio.shortDescription: Analyze Simple Analytics website data in Google Data Studio
